title: Analyse a real fleet log (Supernova) with GYRO data and eRPM
goal: The report on a real flight log names candidate causes with evidence and states what the log cannot tell
privacy: Owner flight logs stay local-only; tests use invented logs.
acceptance: A real fleet log with unfiltered gyro and bidirectional DShot eRPM is decoded locally by src/blackbox.ts
The report names candidate causes with the frequency and motor evidence and states what the log cannot tell
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Owner decision 2026-11-23: the agent analyses a fleet log the owner provides (Supernova); Smoke shaking was an example.
